empty.title: No devices found
empty.description: Try adjusting the search or filters.

create.title: Register device
create.description: Fill in the device data. The token will be shown only once.

platform.label: Platform
platform.immutable-hint: The platform is immutable after creation.

entrance.label: Linked entrance
entrance.hint: The link pre-fills the entrance on events recorded by the device.

status.label: Status
status.active-hint: Active — the device token is valid for sync.
status.inactive-hint: Inactive — the token stops working and the app clears the local cache.

errors.name-max: The name must be at most 100 characters.

detail.title: Device {{name}}
detail.description: Device details, linked entrance and sync.

token.title: Device token
token.description: Token for device "{{name}}" — save it now, it won't be shown again.
token.label: Sync token
token.warning: This token identifies the device when syncing. If lost, rotate it to generate a new one.

rotate.title: Rotate token
rotate.description: Are you sure you want to rotate the token for device "{{name}}"? The current token will stop working and the new one will be shown only once.

delete.title: Delete device
delete.description: Are you sure you want to delete device "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone and the device will no longer be recognized.
